title.zh: TRON Inc.’s TRX came from HTX after UK sanctions
title.en: TRON Inc.’s TRX came from HTX after UK sanctions

current_state.zh: Protos traced TRON Inc.'s daily TRX treasury purchases to an HTX-labeled wallet until shortly after UK sanctions on Huobi Global, after which the firm switched to receiving TRX from an HTX-funded wallet.
